bug_semantics: Stored XSS in the conversion-graph UI: converted MISP/STIX fields are handed to Pivotick HTML-parsing sinks without neutralization. Node labels, sublabels, and edge labels are rendered as HTML; Open raw JSON interpolates JSON.stringify(raw) into win.document.write(); the properties panel and hover tooltip pass attacker-controlled property names/values (including childAttrs keys, hash algorithm names, and STIX types) through Pivotick tryResolveHTMLElement/template.innerHTML. Hovering or selecting a node, or opening raw JSON, can execute markup from converted CTI.
flaw_origin: New Pivotick conversion-graph section first written in 01837b8759efb57d85af9fc77341b406019643c5 (add: [Pivotick] new graph section) inside website/web/templates/convert/detail.html: parseMisp/parseStix copy CTI values into label/sublabel/type, nodeProperties() returns raw strings, and the viewer uses nodePropertiesMap plus an interpolated document.write raw-JSON popup. 11b0bc4583022cd863244af07040fcf5d9405738 later extracted the same sinks into website/web/static/js/graph/convertGraph.js and is a move, not the BIC.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. git cat-file -p 01837b8759efb57d85af9fc77341b406019643c5 shows author/committer ecrou-exact <geffetheo@gmail.com> and message `add: [Pivotick] new graph section (used pivotick) to see misp/stix json` with no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI, or bot trailer.
